mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The absolute Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% over a 3-month period signals a deteriorating labor market, which triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between a binary indicator (UNRATE>4.0%) and 5d forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 300 (indicating high inflation) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.5% (indicating a tight labor market), it signals an overheating economy, which triggers a risk-off reaction and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between a binary indicator (CPIAUCSL>300 AND UNRATE<3.5%) and 20d forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (defined by FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and CPIAUCSL > 300), the S&P 500 tends to underperform, leading to negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between a binary indicator (FEDFUNDS>2.5% AND CPIAUCSL>300) and 60d forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The absolute Rank IC between INDPRO and 20d forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1500.0 (thousands of units) over a 3-month period signals a cooling real estate market, which may prompt monetary easing and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between a binary indicator (HOUST<1500.0) and 5d forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The absolute Rank IC between RSAFS and 20d forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 3.5% over a 3-month period signals a tight labor market, which supports corporate profit growth and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Rank IC between a binary indicator (UNRATE<3.5%) and 20d forward returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
